data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025) was a record year, with revenue of about $130.5 billion, up 114% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was roughly $97.9 billion, which works out to a gross margin of about 75.0%, compared with 72.7% in fiscal 2024. Operating income was approximately $81.5 billion, giving an operating margin of about 62.4%, up from 54.1% the year before. The gross margin was held down slightly by a charge related to inventory provisions and the ramp of the Blackwell architecture late in the year, while operating income benefited from revenue growing much faster than operating expenses, which were about $16.4 billion. These figures come from my recollection of NVIDIA's reported results, so please verify them against the company's 10-K for the fiscal year if you need exact numbers.
